_purpose: D3 — Linear-Probe-Transfer diagnostic. Train a per-bit logistic-regression probe on zA, evaluate same probe on zB without retrain (and symmetric B→A). Drives the decide-phase top_3 routing directly per spec.
_notes: Hyperparameters intentionally identical to D1/D2 (ssl_epochs, ft_epochs, ft_lr, n_seeds_per_config, n_eval_seeds, lambda_c) so the (zA, zB) substrate is byte-equivalent across diagnostics.
Probe regularization (C, max_iter) is identical for both directions — otherwise transfer-ratio comparison is confounded by capacity differences (per spec).

Per-bit logistic regression on 11 bits of the ORACLE_MASKS polynomial basis. Bits where y is all-0 or all-1 in either train or test split are skipped (degenerate; AUROC undefined). Reported as skipped_bits in output.

Bootstrap CI for transfer-ratio: resample test-set ROWS 1000×; for each bootstrap recompute per-bit AUROC and average across non-skipped bits. Probes are trained ONCE on the held-out train split (not refit per bootstrap) to avoid 88-fits × 1000 = 88K refits.
honest-negative gate: if within_auroc_mean < 0.6 in either direction, the §5.7 baseline did not learn the task and this diagnostic is uninformative — emit HONEST_NEGATIVE per spec.
decide-phase routing per spec: ratio≥0.95 → basis-ambiguity (top_3=[A,AC,G]); 0.50–0.94 → partial-linear-compatibility (top_3=[F,G,AC]); <0.50 → linearly-incompatible (top_3=[F,C,AC]).
